title: ever AVIEL|Ruched Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress is made for wedding days that involve real movement?awalking down the aisle, hugging everyone, dancing, and staying comfortable from ceremony to reception. The square neckline gives a clean, modern frame (great for photos), while the flutter sleeves add soft coverage without feeling heavy. Vertical pleats through the bodice keep the look structured and flattering, and the defined waistband creates a clear waistline before the skirt falls into an easy, flowy A line.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Elastic boning.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
